integrity: Analytic proof reconstructed from the published autocorrelation and spherical-transform identities, plus an independent small-support hard-core test proving nonvanishing of reduced diffraction. No finite computation is used as evidence for an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Necessary equality condition only; restricted to the compact-support direct witness class. No existence theorem, no quantitative stability gap, and no extension through the general approximation step is claimed.
title: Sharp hyperbolic linear-programming witnesses require a spherical zero
